card.band: 4 h. Buckets are per dataset. Frontier agents beat the baseline in most trials but average well below the reference. Weaker models stop at default models. Overlaps with the existing tabular rows, so novelty is limited.
card.cheat: Fitting to the visible split does not help on the hidden group shift. The hidden labels are not in the image and the dataset download is not available offline.
card.grading: Scored on a hidden split built by us from held-out groups or time ranges of the same datasets, using the dataset metric, normalised between the shipped baseline and our reference ensemble. Deterministic with fixed seeds.
card.reference: Our reference is a tuned gradient-boosting and tree ensemble pipeline from the repo's reference configs, reaching its normalised score of 1.
card.source: https://github.com/AutoGluon/tabarena @ v0.1.0 (head 041f9b3), Apache-2.0 per the repo metadata. Dataset licences to be confirmed individually.
card.task: /app ships a train split of several of the 51 curated datasets and an evaluation harness. The agent trains and tunes tabular models on CPU within a fixed budget, choosing features, models and ensembling, and submits a prediction script.
card.title: Tabular classification under group shift on TabArena datasets

source_notes: Close to the already_known Grinsztajn tabular benchmark and OpenML-CTR23 (overlap risk for novelty). Its strength is the public, reproducible evaluation protocol. Needs a custom OOD split. Confirm the code licence before use.

spike_plan.kill_if: Default GBDT already reaches over 0.9 of the normalised gap (K8), or most datasets cannot ship under their licence, or no group or time split is definable for most datasets.
spike_plan.pass_if: Tuned ensemble lands clearly above the baseline on most datasets, with normalised headroom left for a stronger agent; all 3 datasets have shippable licences; seeds reproduce scores.
steps: In a throwaway networked container, clone AutoGluon/tabarena and check out tag v0.1.0; confirm whether 041f9b3 is an ancestor or descendant of 8cbe2d0 and pin to the tag commit.
Read the OpenML licence field for suite 457 datasets; keep only datasets whose licence permits shipping train rows.
Pull 3 datasets from suite 457 and define a group or time column for an out-of-distribution split.
Run a default LightGBM/CatBoost baseline and a 20-minute tuned GBDT ensemble on the hidden split, with 3 fixed seeds.
Compute the normalised gap between baseline and tuned ensemble per dataset; check determinism across seeds.
Check that the image would hold only train rows and no cached tabarena data.

v1.summary: The TabArena repo (Apache-2.0), the NeurIPS 2025 paper and the 51-dataset curation are real and confirmed, but the seed's pinned commit is wrong: tag v0.1.0 points to 8cbe2d0, not 041f9b3. The reference configs and per-dataset licences are unverified, and tabular GBDT tuning is close to crowded and public work, so novelty is limited and K8 is a live risk. Proceed to the spike only after the pin is fixed and the licence check passes.
